messages:
Clare: Two huge life updates — I just adopted a senior rescue and named her Rose 🐶, and Alex just got promoted to Staff PM!!! 🎉🎉
Nora: OMG congrats both!!! Rose is the cutest name 🥹 when do we celebrate??
Alex: Thanks y'all! Couldn't have done it without the team's support. Clare's planning a little office get-together on Thursday after stand — casual potluck/mini-toast.
Clare: Yep — thinking 4pm in the kitchen area. No pressure, bring a snack or just your face. Also thinking a small gift for Alex and a welcome kit for Rose (treats, leash, cozy blanket).
Leah: I can do a batch of samosas and a vegan dip. Do we have a sign-up?
Omar: I'll make a quick Google sheet and a card sign-up — dropping link in thread: http://bit.ly/clare-alex-party (placeholder)
Aditi: People Ops can cover a gift card for Alex and a small dog supply voucher. DMing Clare for details. :heart:
Priya: I'll bring cupcakes! Also happy to pick up a little dog toy if Clare wants.
devops-bot: reminder: kitchen fridge clear-out scheduled Thu 3:30pm — please label anything you want to keep.
Clare: Perfect — thanks everyone. RSVP on the sheet if you can make it. Low-key is the vibe, but very grateful for all the congrats ❤️
Nora: RSVP'd! Can I bring sparkling cider?
Alex: Yes please. And Rose will be there for a quick hello (she's very mellow).
Leah: Added samosas + dip to the sheet. See you Thu 4pm! :tada:
